mem-oct12-postgres-conn-exhaust.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion in Staging (Oct 12)

fingerprint.root_exception: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections

mem-oct12-postgres-conn-exhaust.natural_language_summary: High concurrency test depleted SQLAlchemy connection pool without queue buffers, causing cascading 500s across order-service.
mem-oct12-postgres-conn-exhaust.root_cause_analysis: Default SQLAlchemy QueuePool had max_overflow=0 and pool_size=5 with a 10s timeout. When burst traffic arrived, all connection handles locked waiting for PostgreSQL.

remediation.diff_patch:
--- a/config/database.py
+++ b/config/database.py
@@ -14,3 +14,5 @@
-    pool_size=5,
-    max_overflow=0,
-    pool_timeout=10,
+    pool_size=20,
+    max_overflow=30,
+    pool_timeout=30,
+    pool_recycle=1800,
remediation.runbook_summary: Apply connection pool limits and overflow buffers (PR #402). Set pool_size=20, max_overflow=30, pool_timeout=30s.

mem-nov02-order-service-oom.title: Order Service Container OOM Kill (Exit 137)

fingerprint.root_exception: Process out of memory: heap allocation failed / Docker killed with status 137

mem-nov02-order-service-oom.natural_language_summary: Unbounded batch query in Order Service loaded 50,000 JSON records into heap memory at once, triggering Linux cgroup OOM killer.
mem-nov02-order-service-oom.root_cause_analysis: Batch order exporter lacked streaming or pagination, attempting to buffer massive customer payloads in a 512MB Docker container.

remediation.diff_patch:
--- a/services/order_exporter.py
+++ b/services/order_exporter.py
@@ -28,2 +28,4 @@
-    records = db.query(Order).all()
-    return json.dumps([r.to_dict() for r in records])
+    # Stream in chunks of 500 records to prevent memory spikes
+    return StreamingResponse(stream_order_chunks(chunk_size=500), media_type="application/json")
remediation.runbook_summary: Enforce chunked streaming queries (chunk_size=500) and increase container memory limit from 512MB to 1024MB.
